script:
true | exit 3; echo "after s=$?"
echo next
shopt -s lastpipe; true | exit 6; echo after
shopt -s lastpipe; for i in 1 2; do true | break; echo i=$i; done; echo done
for i in 1 2; do true | continue; echo i=$i; done; echo done
for i in 1 2; do true | break; echo i=$i; done; echo done
f(){ true | return 4; echo "in-f s=$?"; }; f; echo "after s=$?"

exit 5 | cat; echo "after s=$?"
echo next
